items.title: World’s largest crypto exchange hit by world’s largest heist
items.brief: Hackers stole over $6 billion in cryptocurrency on Thursday, shattering the record for the largest such heist as multiple investigators pointed the finger at North Korea.

items.title: After decades of boycotts, Palestinian citizens of Israel turned out to vote. It could shape what comes next
items.brief: For decades, many Palestinian citizens of Israel stayed away from the polls, refusing to legitimize a system they say has oppressed their people, sidelined their concerns, and failed to represent them.

items.title: The deeper question raised by the anti-Muslim attacks in Michigan’s Senate race
items.brief: The Republican argument against electing Abdul El-Sayed as a senator is becoming perilously close to, Don’t vote for him because he’s a Muslim.

items.title: Protests and violence now go hand in hand in France. It wasn’t always like this
items.brief: Lucas Petit was just 11 when hundreds of thousands of men and women wearing yellow vests poured onto the streets and occupied roundabouts across France in November 2018.

items.title: 3 dead after 2 helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport, sheriff says
items.brief: Investigators were combing through debris scattered across a field in northwest Oregon Thursday after two helicopters collided midair, killing three people and forcing the closure of a nearby highway, officials said.
